title: The Muppet Movie
about: A banjo-playing frog leaves his Florida swamp for Hollywood and picks up a bear, a pig, a whatever and a rock band on the way, with a frog legs tycoon on his tail.

Hot cheddar nachos.How to make it230g bag plain corn chips400g tin black beans, drained1 tsp ground cumin150g cheddar, grated2 tomatoes, diced1/2 red onion, finely diced1 lime125g sour cream1 avocadoWarm the beans with the cumin and a splash of water, mashing a few.Mix the tomato and onion with half the lime juice and a pinch of salt.Layer the chips, beans and cheese twice in a baking dish and bake at 200°C until the cheese bubbles.Mash the avocado with the rest of the lime and top the nachos with salsa, avocado and sour cream.Bogen County Fair corn cobsPiggy wins the pageant. Honey butter corn.How to make it4 corn cobs, husks off, halved80g butter, softened1 tbsp honey1/2 tsp mild chilli flakes1 lime, cut in wedges30g parmesan, finely gratedMash the butter with the honey, chilli and a pinch of salt.Boil the corn for 4 minutes, then drain.Grill or pan-char the cobs, turning, until spotted brown all over.Brush with the honey butter, scatter with parmesan and serve with lime.Hot salted chipsPotatoes only.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsNot-frog-legs fried chickenKermit turns Hopper down. Buttermilk chicken.How to make it8 chicken drumsticks500ml buttermilk200g plain flour2 tsp smoked paprika1 tsp garlic powder1 L vegetable oil, for frying1/4 white cabbage, finely shredded1 carrot, grated4 tbsp whole-egg mayonnaise1 tbsp cider vinegar2 tbsp mild hot sauceSoak the drumsticks in the buttermilk with a big pinch of salt for at least an hour.Mix the flour with the paprika, garlic powder and salt, and dredge the drumsticks well.Fry in oil at 160°C in batches, turning, until deep golden and cooked through.Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and vinegar.Drain the chicken and serve with the slaw and hot sauce.Desert campfire chilliStuck at a desert campfire. Smoky beef chilli.How to make it750g beef mince1 brown onion, diced2 garlic cloves, crushed2 tsp ground cumin2 tsp sweet paprika800g tinned crushed tomatoes400g tin kidney beans, drained250ml beef stock150g fine polenta150g self-raising flour250ml milk2 eggs80g butter, meltedBrown the mince in batches, then soften the onion and garlic in the same pan.Stir in the spices, tomatoes, beans and stock and simmer gently, stirring now and then.Whisk the polenta, flour, milk, eggs, butter and a pinch of salt into a batter.Pour into a hot greased skillet and bake at 200°C until golden and springy.Serve the chilli in bowls with wedges of cornbread.TreatsRainbow Connection sundaesKermit's banjo in the swamp. Hot fudge sundaes.How to make it1 L vanilla ice cream100g dark chocolate, chopped125ml thickened cream1 tbsp golden syrup250g strawberries, sliced2 bananas, sliced3 tbsp rainbow sprinkles4 glace cherriesHeat the cream and golden syrup, pour over the chocolate and stir until glossy.Scoop the ice cream into 4 tall glasses with the strawberries and banana.Pour over the warm fudge sauce, shower with sprinkles and top each with a cherry.DrinksIdaho sparkling grape fizzThe waiter's Idaho fizz. Frozen grapes on ice.How to make it750ml sparkling white grape juice250ml soda water1 cup green grapes, frozen1 lemonDrop a few frozen grapes into 4 chilled glasses.Fill two thirds with the grape juice, top with soda and add a twist of lemon.Swamp-green lime cordialHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
